title: Is it a deal? Stop guessing. Meet DealCaddie.
blurb: DealCaddie analyzes any rental listing in seconds, on your phone: deal score, rent, taxes and insurance looked up for you, every strategy, comps, an AI analyst, one-link sharing, deals that find you, and Agent Pro for agents.

scenes.line: Analyzing a rental the old way takes hours.
Dig up the taxes. Guess the rent. Hunt down sold comps. Wait on an insurance quote.
Then wrestle it all into a spreadsheet, and most deals still aren't worth it.
You get a deal score and a clear call: buy, watch or pass.
Rent, taxes, insurance and HOA are looked up for you, from real market data.
Change any number, or save your own assumptions as a template. Everything updates live.
See every strategy side by side: long-term, mid-term, Airbnb, Section 8, house hack and BRRRR.
Recent sales and a suggested offer, so you never overpay.
Caddie, your AI analyst, gives you a straight verdict, flags the risks, and answers your questions.
Build your offer plan in one tap: opening, target and walk-away.
Then share the whole deal in one link. Partners and lenders open it on any phone, no login.

do.eval: (async()=>{const L=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const bs=(L||[]).filter(b=>/cleveland/i.test(JSON.stringify(b.markets||'')+' '+(b.name||'')+' '+(b.region_label||'')));if(!bs.length)return 'NO CLEVELAND BOX: '+(L||[]).map(b=>b.id+':'+b.name).join(', ');const b=bs[bs.length-1];const j=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes/'+b.id+'/map',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const rs=(j.rows||[]).filter(r=>r.lat!=null);const good=rs.filter(r=>/analyzed|passed|below_criteria/.test(r.screen_status||''));const use=good.length>=3?good:rs;const med=a=>{a=a.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);return a[a.length>>1]};if(use.length)localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_view_'+b.id,JSON.stringify({lat:med(use.map(r=>r.lat)),lng:med(use.map(r=>r.lng)),z:13,t:Date.now()}));localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_drawer','peek');localStorage.setItem('dc_pin_mode','cf');window.__cleBox=b.id;sessionStorage.setItem('cleBox',b.id);return 'box '+b.id+' '+b.name+' rows '+rs.length+' good '+good.length})()

scenes.line: Set a Buy Box, and the deals come to you: every listing in your market, underwritten and pinned with its cash flow.
New matches land in your inbox every morning.
Agents, Agent Pro puts your name, photo and brokerage on every deal you send.
Each client gets a private portal to rank deals and request showings, so you know exactly who to show first.
Faster, more accurate, and always in your pocket. Stop guessing on deals.
